title: Grade 3 Character & Citizenship: Singapore CCE
description: Core values: Respect, Responsibility, Resilience, Integrity, Care & Harmony.

items.prompt: You accidentally spilled water on your classmate's drawing project. What is the most responsible response?

options.text: Blame the person walking past
Apologize sincerely and help dry the paper and redraw the project
Pretend you didn't notice
Leave the classroom immediately

items.explanation: Taking responsibility and helping repair any damage demonstrates integrity and care.

items.prompt: Your team is losing a sports match at school. What is the resilient attitude to adopt?

options.text: Give up and walk off the court
Encourage teammates, do your best until the whistle, and learn from mistakes
Argue with the referee
Blame the goalie

items.explanation: Resilience means persevering with a positive sporting attitude regardless of adversity.

items.prompt: How can students practice racial and cultural harmony in a diverse school community?

options.text: Respect and celebrate the traditions, languages, and festivals of all ethnic groups
Only sit with people from the exact same neighborhood
Make fun of cultural food
Ignore school cultural events

items.explanation: Living in racial harmony requires mutual respect, openness, and active appreciation of cultural diversity.

items.prompt: What does integrity mean when taking an independent quiz in class?

options.text: Doing your own honest work without peeking at answers or copying others
Sharing answers with a friend quietly
Looking at notes hidden in your pencil case
Changing your test score before showing parents

items.explanation: Integrity means upholding truthfulness and honesty even when no one is watching.

items.prompt: How can you show environmental care in the school canteen?

options.text: Return utensils to tray collection stations and clean up food crumbs
Leave plastic wrappers on the dining table
Throw drink cans into garden bushes
Waste extra food

items.explanation: Practicing civic responsibility keeps shared communal spaces clean and hygienic.

items.prompt: A friend shares a personal secret with you and asks you to keep it safe. What should you do?

options.text: Post it online for others to see
Honor their trust and keep it confidential unless they are in physical danger
Tell everyone at recess
Use it to tease your friend

items.explanation: Being trustworthy builds lasting friendships and maintains mutual respect.

items.prompt: What is the best way to resolve a disagreement with a classmate during group work?

options.text: Listen actively to their perspective and find a fair compromise
Shout louder than them until they agree
Refuse to do any work
Call them mean names

items.explanation: Respectful dialogue and constructive compromise resolve conflicts effectively.

items.prompt: How can an older student be a positive role model to younger primary school students?

options.text: Display courteous behavior, follow school rules, and lend a helping hand
Tell younger children they are not allowed on playground swings
Break rules to appear cool
Ignore school prefects

items.explanation: Setting a positive example inspires younger peers to develop good character habits.

items.prompt: When you receive your pocket money allowance, what is a sound financial habit to practice?

options.text: Spend it all immediately on sweets
Save a portion in your piggy bank before spending the rest wisely
Borrow more money from classmates
Hide it under a rug

items.explanation: Saving a regular portion of money fosters lifelong prudence and financial responsibility.

items.prompt: Why is gratitude an important personal value to cultivate?

options.text: It helps us appreciate the kindness of family and teachers and increases happiness
It makes us feel proud and boastful
It allows us to demand more presents
It is only used on birthdays

items.explanation: Practicing gratitude promotes emotional well-being and strengthens relationships with caregivers and mentors.
